overview_description.description: Cato Networks offers a unified cloud-native platform that integrates networking and security capabilities under a Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) architecture. It provides software-defined WAN (SD‑WAN), a global private backbone, and multiple cloud on-ramps to seamlessly connect branch offices, data centers, remote users, and cloud environments. The platform embeds security services, including firewall-as-a-service, secure web gateway, intrusion prevention, malware prevention, DNS security, and zero-trust network access within its global network. Cato Networks also delivers integrated threat detection and response through SSE 360, extended detection and response (XDR), and endpoint protection, all managed via a single pane of glass with API integration.
